description: Record a lifecycle status against an issued receipt (rcp_* from receipt_issue, or atr_* agent transaction receipts): revoked / disputed / corrected / superseded. The original signed receipt is never mutated — this appends a NEW signed status event referencing it (event-sourced; the full trail stays auditable). Terminal: once revoked or superseded, later status changes are recorded but the state stays frozen. 'corrected' requires corrected_by = the replacement receipt id. Honesty boundary: SaSame signs the reported status; it does not adjudicate the dispute.

corrected_by.description: For status=corrected/superseded: the replacement receipt id (must exist)

reporter_label.description: Self-claimed label of who reports this (unverified)

status_reason.description: Why (bounded free text; shown in the audit trail)

name: receipt_status_set
